description_en: Queries the information about snapshots that are created for a simple application server
description_zh: 查询一个或多个已创建的快照信息
kebab_example: aliyun swas-open list-snapshots --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --instance-id 2ad1ae67295445f598017499dc0000 --disk-id d-bp14wq0149cpp2xy0000 --snapshot-ids '["s-bp16oazlsold4dks****","s-bp16oazlsold4abc****"]' --page-size 10 --page-number 1 --source-disk-type Data --tag Value=TestValue Key=TestKey --resource-group-id rg-aek2bti7cf70000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListSnapshots

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the simple application server that corresponds to the snapshots
parameters.help_zh: 快照对应的轻量应用服务器所属的地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the simple application server
parameters.help_zh: 指定的轻量应用服务器的实例ID
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en: The snapshot IDs. The value can be a JSON array that consists of up to 100 snapshot IDs. Separate multiple snapshot IDs with commas (,)
parameters.help_zh: 快照ID。取值可以由多个快照ID组成一个JSON数组，最多支持100个ID，ID之间用半角逗号（,）隔开
parameters.name: snapshot_ids

parameters.help_en:
The number of entries per page. Maximum value: 100.

Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh:
分页查询时设置的每页行数。最大值：100。

默认值：10
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_zh:
快照列表的页码。

默认值：1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en:
The type of the source disk. Valid values:

system: system disk.

data: data disk
parameters.help_zh:
快照源云盘的云盘类型。取值范围：
System：系统盘。
Data：数据盘
parameters.name: source_disk_type

element_fields.help_en: The key of tag N that you want to add to the snapshot. A tag key can be 1 to 64 characters in length. Valid values of N: 1 to 20
element_fields.help_zh: 快照的标签键。标签键长度的取值范围：1~64。N 的取值范围：1~20
element_fields.name: key

element_fields.help_en: The value of tag N that you want to add to the snapshot. A tag value can be up to 64 characters in length. Valid values of N: 1 to 20
element_fields.help_zh: 快照的标签值。标签值长度的取值范围：1~64。N 的取值范围：1~20
element_fields.name: value

parameters.help_en: Tag N that you want to add to the snapshot
parameters.name: tag

parameters.help_en: The ID of the resource group
parameters.name: resource_group_id
